failure_cases.observed_failure_in_ablation: In the Experiment 2 ablation at `min_score=0.55`, broad multi-entity synthesis queries dilute per-ticker lexical density, causing individual 10-Q footnote sections to score between 0.32 and 0.48 Cosine Similarity.
